Q1.text: Millions of items of the outward order are present to my senses which never properly enter into my experience. Why? Because they have no interest for me. My experience is what I agree to attend to. Only those items which I notice shape my mind---without selective interest, experience is an utter chaos.
Q1.cite: William James, qtd. in Gloria Mark, \textit{Attention Span} (Toronto: Hanover Square Press, 2023), 30
